notes.title: Castlevania Lords of Shadow update.
notes.content:
Castlevania has been updated to  allow you to make the game start in windowed mode. 
This is for http://steamcommunity.com/app/234080/discussions/0/864977479835901859/#p1
To use this enter -windowed in Set Launch Options for the game.
